[Product name masked] is a 24/7 online source for vehicles from [Company name masked], independent auctions, commercial and dealer inventory, and more where dealers can search, bid/buy and make an offer on wholesale inventory. Our applications are written in Ruby/Rails and AWS. We use New Relic, Splunk, and PagerDuty to monitor and alert on our platform.
You'll take full ownership of our applications across design, development, testing, deployment, and support. Our infrastructure is built using the latest AWS technologies. We run an Agile team and our engineering organization is committed to addressing technical debt, alongside driving important business initiatives with Product. If you want to build highly performant software running at scale in the cloud, learn new technologies, and make a real impact on the team, organization, and company, this role is for you.

Ruby on Rails, AWS, TypeScript, NewRelic, Splunk, Docker, GithubActions, CDK, Terraform, Ansible, MySQL DB
cond_0098.responsibilities:

Take ownership of ongoing support, monitoring, and maintenance of deployed products
Drive a culture of passion, trust, and creativity within your agile delivery team

Bachelor's Degree in a related field (preferably Computer Science), or 4 years' experience in a related field

As a Software Engineer I, you'll work on our Online Vehicle Exchange ([Product name masked]) platform. [Product name masked] is a 24/7 online source for vehicles from [Company name masked], independent auctions, commercial and dealer inventory, and more where dealers can search, bid/buy and make an offer on wholesale inventory. Our applications are written in Ruby/Rails and AWS. We use New Relic, Splunk, and PagerDuty to monitor and alert on our platform.
We own and are responsible for our applications from design, development, testing, deployment, and support. Our infrastructure is built using the latest AWS technologies. We are an Agile team and our engineering organization supports addressing technical debt. In addition to working with Product to prioritize important business initiatives. If you want to work on highly performant software running at scale in the cloud, with the ability to both learn new technologies and have an impact on our ability to succeed as a team, organization, and company, this job is for you.
People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of cloud-native systems and how the pieces fit together.
Technologies We Use
Ruby on Rails, AWS, TypeScript NewRelic, Splunk Docker, GithubActions, CDK, Terraform, Ansible MySQL DB
cond_0526.responsibilities:
Design, build, and support solutions for our cloud-native [Product name masked] application
Provide ongoing support, monitoring, and maintenance of deployed products
Engage with your agile delivery team to build a culture of passion, trust, and creativity
cond_0526.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in a related field (preferably Computer Science), or 4 years' experience in a related field
Understanding and experience with object oriented coding
Knowledge of how to design and optimize access of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
Use of distributed version control software such as Git
Preferred Requirements
Familiarity with cloud native software which runs on and integrates in the Cloud, with a preference for AWS technologies
Experience working in an Agile team environment
